generated_discovery.note: Discovery verifies expanded configuration; no generated campaign score is claimed.

validation_scope: Full GNU/musl debug/release suites: 1,561 passing tests each; strict Clippy on both targets, formatting, and coverage/mutation helper checks. Twelve focused mutations run against an isolated source snapshot with library/CLI unit, collections and allocation tests.

earlier_validation.resolution: The full GNU debug run detected the old Re completion expectation. The expected normalized Remove From and Repeat headers were added; production code was unchanged.

review_notes: Collection result planners inspect borrowed admitted arguments before reserving/copying output. Replaced/removed values do not contribute to output metrics, but evaluated arguments remain live through the result build.
Map sorting uses borrowed key/value slots after output admission. Dynamic map construction validates shapes before output copies; duplicate detection occurs during the admitted build.
Invalid compound keys are described by kind so diagnostic measurement does not sort or format an entire map. Large key details use bounded grouped diagnostic construction.
Expanded default registration required exact snapshot/listing count updates. Host and child-scope overrides remain tested and documented.
Focused tests and strict Clippy passed before the full matrix. Initial unit-test compilation fixes and a sort-by-key lint repair were completed before recorded full validation.
limits: This is the documented sixteen-signature collection catalogue, not complete Robot Framework Collections API compatibility.
Ordinary helper arguments copy collection variables before invocation; Get From then copies its selected value. Existing dot/bracket access retains its optimized selected-leaf copy behavior.
Iteration helpers materialize arrays. Sorting uses O(n) borrowed scratch after admission; value metrics are semantic ownership budgets rather than allocator-exact byte limits.
Stops are cooperative. Copy/search loops check control, while a single admitted deep clone, borrowed size walk, equality comparison or sort is not preempted mid-operation.
No Windows/macOS validation, new coverage percentage, full generated mutation score, or release-level performance claim is made by this evidence.

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import subprocess, json, hashlib, re, tempfile, os
root=Path.cwd()
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="collections-",dir=root/"target"))
print(f"validation record: {out / 'summary.json'}",flush=True)
inputs=[p for d in ('src','tests','examples') for p in (root/d).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts]
inputs += sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.md')) + [root/'README.md']
inputs += [root/p for p in ('Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','.cargo/mutants.toml','scripts/coverage.py')]
record={'complete':False,'started':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'input_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in inputs},'checks':[]}
focused=['--test','setup_failure','--test','suite_fixtures','--test','documentation','--test','examples','--test','conformance']
commands=[('gnu-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked']),('gnu-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release']),('musl-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']),('musl-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']),('clippy-gnu',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('clippy-musl',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('format',['cargo','fmt','--all','--','--check']),('coverage-helper',['python3','tests/coverage_tools.py']),('mutation-helper',['python3','tests/mutation_tools.py'])]

try:
 for label,command in commands:
  print('running '+label,flush=True)
  log=out/(label+'.log')
  with log.open('w') as stream:
   result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=1200,env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='2'))
  content=log.read_text()
  rows=re.findall(r'test result: (?:ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',content)
  check={'label':label,'command':command,'status':result.returncode,'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'tests':dict(zip(('passed','failed','ignored'),[sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(3)]))}
  record['checks'].append(check)
  (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps(check),flush=True)
  if result.returncode:
   print(content[-12000:],flush=True)
   raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 record['complete']=True
finally:
 record['finished']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
